conflicts_text: Positive engagement with Axis Invasion and replay contrasts with complaints about tactical constraints, quitters and technical disruption.
notes_text: For Sniper Elite 5 (exact base AppID 1029690, not Resistance), English Steam user sentiment is broadly positive about stealth-shooting, detailed wartime locations and replayable approaches. Some individual reviews object to compressed sightlines/maps, a stronger emphasis on close-range stealth rather than long-distance sniping, reported stutter and separately sold missions. January 2025 Sniper Elite community discussion praises the unusual player-versus-player Axis Invasion mode, while later player discussions describe invasion quitters and balance frustrations. The evidence represents individual reports, not confirmed universal defects or game-wide frequencies.
